detail.longDescription: The Human Technopole's PhD program applications are open until November 30th. An opportunity to work with e.g., Florian Jug or Jan Funke in image processing problems relevant to the biosciences: Jan Funke is recruiting 2 graduate students. Project titles: "Active Learning for Cell Tracking" and "Interpretable Microscopy Image Decomposition". Florian Jug is recruiting 1 graduate student. Project title: "Uncertainty-aware posterior architectures and their application to trustworthy event-driven microscopy and microscopy data analysis". There are many more https:// humantechnopole.it/en/ht-phd-p rogramme/ht-phd-programme-open-positions/ # PhDJobs # microscopy # BioimageInformatics # ComputerVision # MachineLearning
